editorial:
Ever felt like you had to pick between a dream job and the person you love? That is exactly the mess Joshua finds himself in. You get to follow him over a wild 30-day countdown where he has to figure out what actually matters in his life. The vibe is light and breezy, making it the perfect kind of movie to put on after a long day. With a supportive group of friends and a romantic interest who keeps him on his toes, you will feel like you are right there in the room with them as the clock ticks down.

The acting feels natural and the pacing keeps things moving so you never get bored. While the plot is pretty simple and predictable, it is just sweet enough to keep you smiling. If you are looking for a cozy night in, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture quality. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move. It is a solid choice for anyone who needs a feel-good story without too much stress.
endingExplained: At the very end, Joshua realizes that no amount of professional success is worth being lonely. He decides to turn down the big career move and chooses to stay with the woman he loves. After a heartfelt conversation with his friends, he makes his final choice just as the 30 days run out. Everything wraps up happily as he finds a way to balance his work goals while keeping his relationship front and center.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves lighthearted romances and stories about following your heart.
